plan.purpose: Empirical benchmark of effective L1/L2 fluorescence dynamics; no connectome or graded-release parameters are installed.
plan.split: All highLum dark/bright bins per cell train; lowLum and entire natural response held out. Stimulus-level only; no animal IDs.

optimization.restartSelection: Minimum sum of squared training residuals; ties use earliest restart. All restarts must converge before parameter freeze; attempted fits retained separately.
optimization.amplitudeUnits: fractional ASAP2f fluorescence response per unit contrast; no mV conversion

flash.observation: Exact trailing1/120second bins ending at stored t; rest state0 before nominal isolated flash.
flash.baselineLimit: Original randomized repeated flashes and late-gray exponential F0 may retain history; isolated zero-state response is an approximation.

natural.stimulus: First600 quantized values of source sequence2; C=2L−1;300Hz zero-order hold; entire2second stimulus held out.
natural.primaryInitialization: Analytic periodic state using stimulus alone
natural.secondaryInitialization: Zero state; same periodic predicted cycle-mean F0 conversion as primary
natural.observation: Point samples at supplied t_fixed; no delay fitting
natural.normalization: Approximate all-frame F0 using (1+yGray)/(1+exact continuous periodic mean(yGray))−1; retain unconverted periodic and startup diagnostics.
natural.validity: Require positive1+cycleMean and exact interval minimum predicted fluorescence>0 for both initializations. No clipping or alternative fit selection.

metrics.correlation: Pearson, descriptive; unavailable for constant traces

plan.primaryGate: Two-filter natural periodic converted prediction must have smaller fixed-scale RMSE than both zero and one-filter references and positive correlation; all models must have valid predicted fluorescence. Pass is conditional on the observation approximation only. LowLum is secondary out-of-condition evidence; report each contrast and model without gating or retuning.
interpretation: Not a connectome simulation, mechanistic identification, absolute voltage calibration, graded-release model or animal efficacy result.
Natural acquisition onset uncertainty and corrected_fixedtiming lineage remain unresolved; no delay or gain fitted to test responses.
Flash and natural F0 normalization differ; prediction-only conversion approximates slow bleaching and balanced phase sampling, not exact exp2 detrending.
High/low luminance files lack verified physical radiance mapping; no claimed dose, photon-rate or10fold intensity relation.
Compact exports contain52 natural ROI traces but lack animal IDs; no animal-level cross-validation or uncertainty claims.
Fast constants absorb indicator/acquisition dynamics; slow constants may exceed the measured flash window and are not uniquely physiological.
